technique_name: Compare and contrast the American and Chinese education systems.
description: The American and Chinese education systems differ in many respects. In the US, education is highly decentralized with each state and local community having its own systems of teacher certification, curriculum and assessment standards. The US education system also has greater emphasis on individual achievement, encouraging children to become independent thinkers, problem solvers and innovators.
